raw_text: BREAKING: Thousands of Bengali-speaking families in Barak Valley have taken to streets after NRC supplementary exclusion list published overnight. NH-6 completely blocked near Silchar. Police deployed but not intervening yet. Local leaders calling for indefinite bandh until list is withdrawn.
clean_text: Thousands of Bengali families in Barak Valley protesting NRC supplementary exclusion list. NH-6 blocked near Silchar. Local leaders calling for indefinite bandh.
